name: Hive 1.2.3
notes: Fixes a runtime-switching regression: once you added a second runtime (e.g. Codex), switching a chat back to Claude Code failed with 'unknown runtime id claude-code'. Claude Code is the built-in bring-your-own CLI runtime (surfaced by the runtime list but not a saved config entry), so the per-chat switch now accepts it the same way the default-runtime setter already did. Also carries 1.2.2's macOS file-access helper and 1.2.1's runtime Test button + turn timeout.
